arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b
select "c" t,key k,value v,"" x from cache union all select "f",flight_id,fare_cents||" cap "||capacity,* from flights union all select "h",* ,"","" from fare_holds
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("flights","cache","fare_holds","customer_events")

select "c" t,key a,value b,"" c from cache union all select "f",flight_id,price_cents,capacity||" v"||version from flights union all select "h",flight_id,price_cents,until_step from fare_holds union all select "e",request_id,kind,step from customer_events

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.request_id,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured") ch,(select count(*) from refunds r where r.booking_id=b.booking_id) rf from bookings b where b.request_id in (select request_id from customer_events)
